title: THE RELIGIOUS PEER PRESSURE OF FRED PRICE JR

sense.text:
“For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers.” That is what Fred Price Jr. is doing, or trying to do: preparing himself for the search of his fathers, his ancestry, his lineage. He is seeking self. His father preached on the table of nations in Genesis 10, and that opened his mind to finding out who the nations of the Bible are today, where black people come from. You won't find that in the Quran or in the Book of the Dead of Egypt. The only book where our people's lineage can be found is the Bible.

He is saying what a lot of celebrities will not say. Kyrie Irving, Ye, DeSean Jackson, and a guest on Nick Cannon's show all sought knowledge of self, and they all caught hell on earth. Whenever we seek knowledge of self, we are met with obstacles, and that is why he is hesitant.

“For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow.” The days are the former age, the days of our fathers in their time on the earth.

“Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?” The words out of their heart are the words of our fathers in times past. This Bible is a compilation of the letters of our fathers, and we must search it out, or rather they will teach us who we are, where we belong, who our God is, and where each tribe, where Levi, belongs. DNA testing is nice, but you have to go into this Bible to find these things out.

precepts.why:
“Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments. Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord.” The Lord was going to send Elijah the prophet, whoever he may have been, and if we are all here, he was sent already. The great and dreadful day itself has not come yet.

“And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children.” The heart of the fathers is the Bible: the mind of the fathers, the words out of their heart that Job spoke of. The children are the fathers. All God is doing is bringing back to our memory what we were before, because Isaiah is here, Jeremiah is here, Daniel is here. That is on a higher level. On a lower level, he is turning us back to our ancestry, back to our forefathers: “and the heart of the children to their fathers”, back to our lineage and who we are.

“Lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.” If he did not do it, he would have to destroy the earth, and he is not going to, because he sent Elijah. It all started with Abba Bivens, whom some believe may have been Elijah, the forerunner of the very movement the host wants dismantled. You cannot stop what the Lord has started. The word of God cannot be stopped.

sense.text:
“This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power”. Zerubbabel was a warrior and had it in his mind to take over. The Lord said no: you can break bones, but this is not the time. Now is the time to build your people, to build your nation, to build the temple. You don't have time to be out fighting heathens. Not by might, not by power, the military, the physical.

“But by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.” The word of God is what we use to dismantle this whole system, this world. An elder at our home church, one of the best teachers of all time in our community, stood in Times Square, the same place where the host saw us, and said: this is the book that is going to destroy your world.

We don't have nukes. We don't have the power or the pull they have. We don't have the Epstein files, cameras filming everybody, dirt on everybody. What we have is the word of God, and that is dangerous enough. The host is asking a pastor how to dismantle it. You can't.

precepts.why:
“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”, “Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”. This is the only book, the only word, that can do these things: cast down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God.

“And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.” That is when you can do it: when your obedience is fulfilled.

The weapons of our warfare are not carnal. We are not going to war with this man with guns; people will lose. You going to buy bullets from the white man to fight the white man, while the white man sells you the bullets? Buy nukes from the white man to nuke the white man? God damn it, don't make no sense.

But mighty through God. When pastors and hosts are asking each other for help to dismantle us, we are the ones dismantling. We are casting down imaginations without any weapons at all. In 2019 we marched into the church and shut it down, outnumbered by the thousands, camps all up the street and on the corners, and every apologist who came up was destroyed, group after group. That is why they consider us public enemy number one: a bunch of Negroes standing on the corner with the book, and we are a threat to society.

sense.text: Shemaiah told Nehemiah, “Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee”. Your life is in danger, Nehemiah; let's go hide somewhere.
“Should such a man as I flee?” Why should I run? Run for what? Who am I to go and hide? “I will not go in.”

“And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him”. Nehemiah realized God was not dealing with this man: he was telling a leader to run and hide. God didn't send him; he was a demon. “For Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.” Heathens hired this brother. He was a sellout, hired to convince Nehemiah to run and hide as a leader.

“Therefore was he hired”: he sold his people out. “That I should be afraid, and do so, and sin”. To be fearful is sin. “And that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.” That was the plan: so they could say, look at your elder trying to hide in the temple to save himself. Nehemiah said, I am not going anywhere; God obviously didn't send you.

That fearful spirit Fred Price shows in the video is the symptom of a man who is not ready to lead. This movement is life-threatening; believe it or not, it is a suicide mission. What Trump and that administration have set in motion will not stop whether he is removed physically or executively. America is reverting back to what she once was. Many who act gangster, with all the smoke for their own kind and none for the other, will see where their opps are when these white folks roll up and start putting bullets in their heads.

Israelites who bad-mouth MLK, Malcolm and the Panthers don't have the same testicular fortitude those men had, who faced the white man in his pure form, when he was not hiding who he was. Them white folks back then would put a bullet in your head and say you hung yourself, and they do it now. The so-called white man of the '60s is beginning to show his head again, and the black man of today is not ready for the white man of yesterday. Our elders, the Bishop among them, were a different caliber of men. You are not built for what is rising now.

precepts.why:
“The fear of man bringeth a snare”. It is a trap. The man who fears man can't say what he really wants to say. Fred Price can say what he wants to say, but then he has to backtrack and fix himself. That is the fear of man.

“But whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.” If he trusted in the Lord, the true God of Israel, his God, he wouldn't care; he would say what he has to say and take the risk. A lot of our people are not built for the risk.

“Say to them that are of a fearful heart”: that is what we are saying to Mr. Price. A fearful heart is what he has. “Be strong, fear not”. Fear not, Fred. Be bold.

“Behold, your God will come with vengeance”. Our God is coming with vengeance against our enemies. He is not coming to save our enemies; he is going to avenge us of them. “Even God with a recompence”, because God does not forget. Negroes do. Most of us have never seen real justice since we've been here. Prison time is temporal justice, not God's justice. God's justice says: you had us in chains, now we have you in chains; you put us to death by the sword, you die by the sword.

“He will come and save you.” Not your pastor, not your priest, not your politician. Your God will come and save you.

“Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men”. Don't fear what men say.

“Neither be ye afraid of their revilings.” Don't be afraid when they say you are Black Hebrew Israelites, a cult, a hate group, terrorists. A lot of our people will say they believe some of what we say, but they don't want to be part of that reviling, because they are fearful.

“And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.” When Paul was locked up for the Lord's sake, it encouraged and empowered the disciples. When tribulation came, the real disciples were not moved by fear; they were moved to teach with more boldness.

In Black Messiah, the authorities would not simply lock up Fred Hampton, because as long as he was alive in jail he was a martyr and the movement continued; they said he must be neutralized. In the same way Paul in prison made the truth more real to the brethren.

When we say tribulation is coming, we mean it. When you see us handcuffed and dragged out of here, we will see what you are made of: some will run down the block to the Catholic church. But some will be made men that day: Deacon so-and-so is in prison, Bishop so-and-so is in prison, so-and-so got exiled or killed; what they taught was right all along. It will embolden you to push this truth even harder at the peril of your own life.

Speak the word without fear: “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.” You believe what you believe and you don't waver. You know what you know, and no one can tell you otherwise.

They bring up the trinity. Do you keep God's commandments? No? Then let's deal with what is important. All we know is that Christ is the son of God; that is what he told us and that is what we believe. Not that Harvey Dent god, two in one with a coin, father on one side, son on the other, the coin the Holy Ghost. That DC comic god, that two-face trinity doctrine, is garbage to us.

sense.text:
Fred Price says he is not saying the Ashkenazi Jews are not Israelites, and that Hebrew Israelite theology goes so far as to call them the synagogue of Satan of Revelation 2. It is not Hebrew Israelite theology; the Bible says it. He won't go that far, so we have to, and we will go further if we have to. That is the peer pressure: he cannot fully say they are not who they say they are, because he has too much to lose. Many of these pastors went to prestigious seminaries and are on a payroll; their churches are funded by institutions run by the so-calleds, the little hats, and if they step outside that curriculum they lose the funding. Candace Owens has more balls than he does: she told the rabbi to his face, Revelation 2:9, that he is the devil. She is married to Esau, which is crazy, a walking anomaly, but she has more sense and more balls than a lot of these brothers, these men, who know what she is saying is true.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. That is the real Israel, rich as a nation.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” Keep that word blasphemy in mind. The synagogue of Satan is the chief house of the devil. Christ called them the devil, and that is why they don't believe in Christ. The Orthodox reject the New Testament altogether, and their Talmud, which they hold in high esteem, says Christ is in hell burning in his own excrement. Some will lie and say they don't say that, but it is in their literature.

precepts.why:
“Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie”: they lie about being Jews.

“Behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet”. Thy feet are John and his people, the real Israelites. That is justice: take that little hat off and bow down to the real chosen people of God. “And to know that I have loved thee”: the real Israelites.

We are the descendants of the man; they just live in the land. They are renters, squatters, like someone who moves into your house and says it is his, while your pictures are still on the wall. A black man is on the wall, and they say, that's me, I'm Jesus. And we believe it. They will tell you the truth about how they feel about your Christ right to your face, and still you cannot say they are not the children of Israel.

sense.text: “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir”. Mount Seir is Esau, so this is against Edom, against the nation of Edom. “And prophesy against it”: prophesy what we are doing today. Even the video itself shows clip after clip of Edomites, Edomite pastors among them, saying they are not the real Jews. We don't need a cosigner; the Bible says what it says.

“Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.” He will destroy them and devour them. “I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.”

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: a hatred that has gone on for centuries, from Esau their father down through his children toward us. Perpetual means they are born with it. It is in their blood to hate us; it is damn near biological. That is why they do such terrible things to us: eating us, hanging us, castrating us, raping us, mutilating us, cutting off our hands and legs.

There was a sister whose husband they killed. When she went to court about it, they hung her from a tree, shot her full of holes, cut her belly open so the baby fell out, stepped on the baby's head and set it on fire. That is a perfect hatred. There is no record of black folks ever doing that to white folks. What was done to the French in Haiti was retaliation; she was innocent. God put it in them from the womb to the tomb. You cannot change them. God lifts the restraint off of them when he wants to show their true nature.

“And hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”. Our iniquity had an end at the emancipation proclamation, and still they could not stop: the KKK, black codes, Jim Crow, the convict leasing system, redlining, poisoned water and food, medical apartheid. Whatever they do has to affect us in some way.

“I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood”. They don't hate killing us. “Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate”. “And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers”: wherever they go, he will kill them.

“I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. What is God saying in this chapter? I am going to eradicate your race. This is God pronouncing a divine genocide.

“Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”. The two nations are Judah and Ephraim, Judah and Israel. The two countries back then were Judea and Samaria; later they became Israel and the Americas. Edom took both: one as the Romans, who later became the Israelis, and the other as Christians, the conquistadors.

“I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them”. Esau was the firstborn and felt it was not fair: why did God choose him and not me? I should be God's chosen people; I should have the chosen land. That envy is what fuels the perpetual hatred they have for us, and they use it as hatred against us.

“And that I have heard all thy blasphemies”. Remember Revelation 2:9, the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews and are not. Edom's blasphemy is to take the land and say, I am the people too, I am the one who belongs here. This is a direct precept to Revelation 2:9 and 3:9: possessing the land and the countries and professing to be the people who belong there.

“Saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” You are in slavery now; we have the land. They have said it to our face: yes, you are the real Jews, you are the Israelites, Christ is black, so what? The land is ours now. They know; the world doesn't. “Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.”

“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.” When there is no more Edom on the earth, the earth rejoices. As long as that nation is on the earth, the earth can have no peace. Edom is the world's problem: animals made extinct, the water and air polluted, fake plants, gayness spread over the earth, transgenderism, false religions, war, nuclear bombs, drugs. It is always them. We in the ghetto are not hunting animals until they are dead or shooting bald eagles. We did not wipe out the Native Americans, the Aztecs, the Incas, the Mayans. Edom is the source of the world's problems.

“As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate”. The inheritance is our land and our culture, our race; heritage is your race, your culture, your laws, your identity. They rejoiced because they destroyed us, enslaved us and scattered us all over the world. “So will I do unto thee”.

“Thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”. He makes it clear: even all of it. He is not saving some of them. Clap for your half-white, your white Edomite mamas, grannies, uncles and aunts too; they will be destroyed too. Just in case you say, but I'm half: your father is the part that matters. The white part don't matter. You ain't mixed; you are confused.

precepts.why: Who or what is mount Seir? “Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” Esau's dwelling is Seir, so when the Bible prophesies against Seir, it is prophesying against Esau, against Edom. With that context, no one can say we are making it up.

sense.text:
Solomon is prophesying of the wicked elders of our people: the Pharisees, the Sadducees, the scribes and the chief priests, the enemies of Christ in his day. Those same people were later overthrown by the Romans and fled into the Caucasus Mountains, where they taught the Khazars Babylonian Talmudism, and the Khazars learned from us how to be Jews and became us. So this is twofold: the wicked of our people then, and the impostors of our people today. The Israeli today is the Pharisee today, upholding the same doctrine Christ and the Lord despised.

“Let us oppress the poor righteous man, let us not spare the widow, nor reverence the ancient gray hairs of the aged.” That is them today toward our people.

“Let our strength be the law of justice”. Who controls the legal system, the banking system, finance, real estate? Edom controls all of it: the law, who is in office, politics, the media, fashion, even the music and hip-hop. MLK's I Have a Dream speech was written by their pen and came out of his mouth; his mountaintop speech was the real one, where he told Harry Belafonte he had made a mistake and integrated his people into a burning house.

“For that which is feeble is found to be nothing worth.” We are the feeble.

“Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous”: let's plot against them, pass laws secretly to thwart them, imprison them, exile them, kill them. “Because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings”. We are not for their turn, and we are clean contrary to the terrible things they do secretly and openly.

“He upbraideth us with our offending the law”. We rebuke them for saying they are us when they are not. “And objecteth to our infamy the transgressings of our education.” The Talmud is garbage, straight trash, a lie: a book of arguments and opinions by a bunch of ignorant Negroes, added to later on over the centuries.

“He professeth to have the knowledge of God: and he calleth himself the child of the Lord.” We do: we call ourselves Israelites, the children of God. “He was made to reprove our thoughts.” When the wicked come into existence, the Lord sends the righteous afterwards. We are literally made to correct their evils.

“He is grievous unto us even to behold”. They can't stand how we look. “For his life is not like other men’s, his ways are of another fashion.” We don't follow their ways or their media.

“We are esteemed of him as counterfeits”. We esteem them as counterfeits, impostors, posers. “He abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness”: they hate the Bible. “He pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed, and maketh his boast that God is his father.” That is speaking of Christ first, but of us also.

“Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him.” Let's see if these people who say they are Israelites are true. They say it because they are responsible for the end of him: his brakes went out, his plane went down, a brain aneurysm, poison, a cancer out of nowhere, or a video of him robbing a store. Where is his God now?

“For if the just man be the son of God, he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.” If you are really of God, he will heal you. That is their mindset.

“Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture”. If that doesn't kill you, they will torture you to death. The Mossad and the IDF torture and rape their inmates, men and women, as they are doing to the Palestinians. “Let us condemn him with a shameful death”: that is the end of him, because they are behind it.

“Such things they did imagine, and were deceived: for their own wickedness hath blinded them.” God has other plans for us. They can do what they want with this body, but we will come back. The scariest Negro to a white man is one he can't kill: a righteous army he can never kill again, can't bribe, drug, lie on, poison, shoot or nuke. Satan tells them once you kill them it is over, but they don't believe what comes after.

precepts.why:
“For the terrible one is brought to nought”. The terrible one is Edom, who does terrible things to all nations behind the scenes to keep power and authority on the earth. He is brought to nothing, destroyed as Ezekiel 35 said. “And the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off”.

“That make a man an offender for a word”: that is why their strength is the law of justice. They pass laws so that if you say certain things you face jail, exile, banishment, even death; they want to bring back beheadings, the guillotine. “And lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate”: snares in the legal system, the music, the media, for him who teaches in the streets. “And turn aside the just for a thing of nought.”

“They hate him that rebuketh in the gate”: in the streets, at the gate. “And they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.”

So they pass laws to make those who reprove offenders for their words: hate speech, terrorism, treason, unpatriotic, anti-MAGA. You are against abortion, against same-sex, against white supremacy, you say we are fake Jews: lock him up, give him five years, fire him, fine him thousands, put a lien on his house. They will do these things because they can.

sense.text:
Fred Price says there is the Khazar theory, that Turkic people converted to Judaism but are not genealogically Israelites, and that both arguments can be strong. There are not two arguments; there is one argument, and one side is true and one is not. The truth is that they were Khazars, and they converted in the 8th and 9th century.

“A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.”

Arthur Koestler was not the only one who showed they were Khazars. Many authors and geneticists brought the evidence; the geneticist Elhaik went to the Khazar burial mounds and said these are Eastern Europeans. Coins and documents were found. Koestler became the most popular, and he and his wife met an untimely end. Fred Price cannot land on a side because it messes with his money, as with Nick Cannon, who was sat down and re-educated and now calls the Bible a myth, but never said so to their faces.

Even the professor of their own kind in the video says there is a historical basis: King Joseph's letter has been substantiated, coins were found with the name Moses, and the conversion is dated to 740, or by most historians to the 800s. They converted and changed their names.

Their own Jewish Encyclopedia, prepared by more than 400 of their scholars, says the Khazars were a people of Turkish origin who ruled South Russia, what was later Ukraine, until the Russian prince Sviatoslav made war on them, conquered Khazaria and annexed it, which is how Ukraine, once Khazaria, became part of Russia; that the Crimea was known to travelers as Gazaria, Khazaria, until the 13th century; that Hasdai ibn Shaprut, one of our people and foreign minister to the caliph of Cordova, wrote to their King Joseph; that the Khazars once dwelt in the Seir mountains, and Seir is Edom; that they were instructed in the Bible, the Mishnah and the Talmud and took Israelite names like Obadiah, Hezekiah, Manasseh and Isaac; and that many Khazar heathens became Jews. Members of the royal family went to Spain, became conquistadors, and took this side of the world as Christians while taking the land of Israel as Israelis: the two countries of Ezekiel 35.

Why is Fred Price Jr. so confused? “Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad”: angry, crazy. We are a crazy people and an angry people because we are an oppressed people, oppressed for a very long time and in many ways.

“And a gift destroyeth the heart.” A gift destroys the mind, the integrity of a people, of a man, of a leader: money, bribery, creature comforts.

precepts.why:
“Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise”. These so-called Israelites are known for giving gifts. They are behind the endorsements, the funding of the churches, the basketball teams, music, media, record deals, the record labels and fashion. Fred Price is a smart brother, but the funding, and the fear of losing it by speaking the truth flat out instead of being two-sided and double-minded, makes it too risky.

“And stop up his mouth that he cannot reprove.” It stops his mouth so that he cannot correct them and say: you are impostors, you are not the real people of the land; you converted in the 8th century, you came out of the Seir mountains into Eastern Europe and Russia and stayed heathen, until the Jews who fled there from the Roman Empire converted you. They turned a race into a religion. The Jews were always a nation, a race of people, and our religion was part of our race; it is one and the same.

“Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth”: men who don't lie. “Hating covetousness”: that is bribery, taking presents and gifts.

“And place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens”. These were the men set over our people: men of integrity, content with their wages, not looking to get paid off or bought off, or hired like the man Sanballat and Tobiah hired against Nehemiah. You can't be bought or silenced with money: AIPAC, the SPLC, Canary Mission, that is all them.

sense.text:
Fred Price says that because of Deuteronomy 28:68, the Hebrew Israelites may be on to something, and the host who brought him on to dismantle us has no answer. He can't help you; he believes it too.

“From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia”. The rivers of Ethiopia are the Nile, the White Nile and the Blue Nile; beyond is the other side, West Africa. “My suppliants”: those who pray to him. “Even the daughter of my dispersed”. Israel was dispersed along the White and Blue Nile and beyond it on the same continent: West Africa, the Congo, the Sahara, north, south, east and central Africa. Go there and you will see them.

Those who say the people over there are Hamites haven't been there. We have seen Ham and Shem over there, and there is a big difference, and Ham will tell you: I am Nilo, the Bantu are over there. In Zambia they all have biblical names: Moses, Jeremiah, Noah, Gershom, Aaron, Peter, Paul, Blessing, Wisdom. They look like us; put a hat on them and keep them quiet and you would think they were one of us. If we were abundant in Egypt as slaves, how much more abundant in Africa as exiles? Jake makes babies all over the place, lawfully and unlawfully, in a warm, tropical climate, and in the Caribbean forget it. And those who call us Hamites can afford a bunch of wives but can't afford a passport to go find their people.

“Shall bring mine offering.”

“And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse”: that is Christ, “which shall stand for an ensign of the people”. The ensign is Christ, the word of God.

“To it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.” The Gentiles are explained as we read on. Heathens do not need rest; we are the ones in slavery. Rest from what? Saved from whom, from us? Ridiculous.

“The Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people”. His people are the Gentiles who get the rest in verse 10.

“From Assyria”: between Turkey, Iran, Iraq and Syria, the Afro-Iraqis, Afro-Iranians, Afro-Syrians and Afro-Turks. “And from Egypt”: Sudan. “And from Pathros”: South Sudan, where our people are still conquered; the Israelis openly admitted destabilizing Sudan to destroy us there, and the slave trade there goes on today. “And from Cush”: Ethiopia, the Tigrayans and Eritreans, Shemites being slaughtered. “And from Elam”: Persia, Pakistan, Iran. “And from Shinar”: Iraq. “And from Hamath”: the Afro-Syrians. “And from the islands of the sea”: the islands of the Atlantic, the Pacific and the Indian Ocean; we are on all of them.

“And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.” Verse 10 says Gentiles and verse 12 explains the nations: the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah, gathered a second time from these lands so we can receive glorious rest. That is context, not heathen love, for some of you confused Negroes out there.

precepts.why:
“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other”. He said he will gather the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah from the four corners, because he scattered us from one end of the earth unto the other.

“And there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.” Wood is Christianity and stone is Islam, the two most prominent religions on the earth.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. Egypt represents bondage. The first time, we walked into Egypt; this time it is by ships. That is why Isaiah 11 says he will recover us the second time.

“By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again”: the way he said it is how it will happen, and the Egypt we walked out of we will never see again.

“And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.” No man will save us from this bondage. Moses saved us from the first Egypt, but from this one no man can save us; Esau was given too much power. Christ died and saved us from our sins, but our physical deliverance comes from the Son coming not as a man but as what he once was, a god. Your God will come and save you.

sense.text:
Fred Price says he can agree with the history and take issue with the theology. You cannot separate the two: if the Jews of the Bible are black, and he acknowledges it, the history and the Bible go hand in hand. Saying white-skinned Jews are not the first Israelites is wrong; there are not first Jews, there are the first and only. Everyone in Genesis 10 was black, and the so-called white man came into existence fifteen chapters later in Esau, Genesis 25. Saying they are not the first Jews is him trying to save them. He mentions Joseph marrying an Egyptian woman.

“And he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti–pherah priest of On.” Pharaoh gave Joseph an Egyptian wife; that is true. “And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt.”

“And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came”, from the Egyptian woman: Manasseh the firstborn, and Ephraim the second. The Egyptians were very tall and dark, so Ephraim and Manasseh were more than likely tall and big. Bottom line, they were black. Joseph was already black.

precepts.why:
“And Joseph was the governor over the land”. He became the vizier of Egypt, second under Pharaoh, because the Lord gave him to understand the vision of the famine to come. “And Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.” The famine was over all the known world, but Egypt was spared because Joseph prepared, so his brothers came from Canaan to buy food: the same brothers who envied him and sold him into slavery.

“And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them”. He acted as if he did not know them. “And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.”

Say these were white Jews. The Egyptians of that time were black, jet black and tall. A short white governor with a clean-shaven face and makeup, among a bunch of black people, and a group of white brothers don't recognize their own brother? That makes no sense. If Joseph passed for one of the Egyptians, clean-shaven with makeup on, he would blend in just fine. That is why they didn't recognize him.

“We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul”. They complained among themselves about how they treated Joseph, and Reuben said, “Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.” It is our fault.

“And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.” They spoke about him in front of him in their Hebrew tongue, and he understood but pretended not to. Joseph had learned the Egyptian language and spoke to them through an interpreter. He passed for a flat-out Egyptian, language and everything. Joseph passed for an African people. It would be like Eminem standing among the Egyptians in makeup; he would stick out like a sore thumb.

“Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.” Jacob passed away, and Pharaoh gave Joseph leave. “With him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt, And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house”. The Egyptians came to support him, and his own family with him; only the little ones and the flocks and herds stayed in Goshen. “And it was a very great company.”

“And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.”

“And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites”: the Canaanites are Hamites, an extremely dark people. They saw this funeral procession and said, “This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians”. They called the whole company Egyptians, Joseph and his family included. They didn't say look at the Hebrews and the Egyptians. “Wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim”: Abel is mourning, Mizraim is Egypt, the mourning of the Egyptians. Hamites called other Hamites and Hebrews alike Egyptians. The Israelites passed for Egyptians, black like them.

sense.text:
Fred Price lists the dark-skinned people of scripture: Abraham's household of Canaanites and Eberites, the Benjamite Cush in Psalm 7 whose name means black, Sheba, Moses marrying Zipporah the Midianite, people who became the Somalis. He says it is irrefutable, that you have to work overtime to ignore it, and that it set him on the journey to look into what we have been preaching. The host brought him on to help dismantle us, and he said, they're right. It is like Balak and Balaam: why don't you curse them? It isn't working.

“For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.” This is happening right now, all over the world, in the streets, and on this show: he cannot gainsay nor resist what we are saying.

precepts.why: “And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake. Then they suborned men”. They could not withstand what Stephen was saying; they couldn't fight it. All they could do was agree and get mad.

“And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?” Christ didn't go to a seminary or a theology school of old. They asked how this man knew the scriptures so well when he never came to their school of learning.

sense.text: Because Christ was so sharp and quick-witted, after a while they found him to be a threat to their religious institutions. “Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.” He is winning people over; what do we do with this man?

“If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.” Their place is their position. Here we learn the elders of the Jews were in the pocket of Rome. Rome sustained them, their place and their nation, and Christ was a threat to their existence and their hold over the people. They were supporters of Rome.

precepts.why:
This is not new; it was prophesied that our rulers were always this way, even before Rome came along. “Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.”

“We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement”. That is what the elders did: made a covenant with the nations, with Rome, for presents and gifts. That is why the pastors can't stand ten toes down on what we teach: they are at agreement with hell.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us”. They believe they will be safe, like the pissraelites, the play-it-safe Israelites who teach a safe doctrine and think they won't be deemed the radical ones. They will give it to all of us; they will just get you last. “For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”.

“Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.” Drunk on religion, and on pity and empathy, which is a weakness too. The pissraelites in the comments saying the Gentiles of Isaiah 11 are the actual nations, the good heathens who will seek the Lord and be saved together with us, are the play-it-safe Negroes, the house Negroes who would have had Nat Turner and Gabriel Prosser killed: master is good to us, we eats good, I make six figures.

The Bible is harmonious. Israel was in their land, rebelled against their God, got kicked out and scattered abroad; they will repent where they were scattered, be put back in their land and rule again. When Israel rebelled, the nations ruled over them; when Israel ruled, we ruled over the nations. Somewhere in a Negro slave mind, God will save the good heathens from slavery and put them in the kingdom, but he did not spare the good of his own people when we were rebellious. Daniel wasn't wicked, and he went into captivity. Ezekiel wasn't wicked, and he went into captivity. He didn't spare his chosen people, but he will spare the heathens because they are so good? Make it make sense. Y'all make us sick.

“The prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.” “And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed”. That is the host asking the learned pastor to dismantle the doctrine, and he can't: I believe, I see what they are saying, I get the history but not the theology, I have to do more research.

“And their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men”: the seminary schools, the cemetery schools, the theology schools. Their fear toward God is taught by the doctrine of men. That is where their theology stands, and why some carry the house Negro spirit, trained in the slave doctrine of white supremacist Christianity.

“Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people”: that work is us. “For the wisdom of their wise men shall perish”. It is happening now: Christianity is dying, the pastors have no answers, the priests have no understanding.

“Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?” The Israelis and the nations fund the World Council of Churches that educates these pastors to keep us ignorant of who we are by this Bible. Secret elite families behind the religious system and the media, the order, the deep state, revise the Bibles and change the meanings of words. They are behind the same pastors who made a covenant with death and hell.

“Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not?” What they turn upside down, God will turn right side up. They despise God and say there is no God.

sense.text:
Fred Price says he did an ancient DNA test. The DNA companies cannot take you that far back: they don't have David's or Moses' DNA; they go off people living in the Middle East today and give probability, not certainty. Their own spokesman admitted it is less than 0.1% of your ancestry; eight generations back you have 256 great-grandparents, twenty generations back over a million. And over in Israel they put major obstacles in the way of DNA testing, because they don't belong there. Christ said my sheep hear my voice; we just teach.

Here is how we search who we are, as Job 8 said, search of the fathers, and Malachi 4, turning the heart of the fathers to the children: “Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.” All the prophecies and history revolving around the children of Israel point to who Israel is. The Bible is a historical book, a foundation for other historical texts as long as they corroborate it. The Bible is the true DNA test; the prophecies are the DNA test.

To those who say we are Hamites wishing to be Jews: show us a scripture where God returns his people as a whole into the land after 70 AD, before the Messiah's return. According to prophecy, God or his son puts all twelve tribes back in the land at the Messiah's return, and there is no more war in the land when they are there. If you are there before he comes, you don't fit this Bible.

Fred Price says his test shows him 21% Judah, 12% Levi, some Zebulun and Simeon: all twelve tribes in one man, like Voltron or Captain Planet. No, brother: 100% Judah, if anything. He has to come and learn.

“And they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers”. Your genealogy is based on your father. Some will say, from that video, that we don't know who our fathers are. True, but the Bible tells you who your father is, and Christ said my sheep hear my voice. If you hear this Bible and see that it is speaking of your people, it is you. Deuteronomy 28, Lamentations, the whole book, the curses, the prophecies and the history prove who you are. Let the angels do the rest; they are the DNA testers.

By prophecy the African Americans are Israelites, Judah. Argue which tribe if you want: everyone on our chart is an Israelite, on this side of the earth or the other. You cannot argue prophecy, history, the slave ships, the yokes of iron, the diaspora.

Fred Price says they are on to something: the slaves were descendants of Shem, there were Hebrews in West Africa before the slave trade, and after the Assyrian captivity many Israelites made their way into Africa. He knows; he is on point there.

To show a distinction: “Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation”. God took a nation out of another nation. Even though the Israelites and the Egyptians were both black, dark people, they were two separate nations.

This is a message for brother Fred Price: you have to come and learn. You are trying hard to avoid us, but you are already at the door; just open it.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction”: that is our people. “Yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers”. We know he is watching, and brothers like him are watching. Come and learn, or watch online wherever you feel comfortable, but understand that a lot of what you learned in seminary school is a lie.

“And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.” Many try to walk away from the truth, but they hear it behind them. Many walked past us teaching in the street, but the seed was planted and eventually they came around. The seed is planted in him; he is coming around.

precepts.why: “And I will give you pastors according to mine heart”: that is us in this room, this organization. “Which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding”: understanding, with all confidence, that there is no such thing as white-skinned Jews or Israelites. We are the Israelites according to the Bible.
